records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Works
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: A quick next step for Vantage Works
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge and dark mode — both tickets are closed on our side now, and as Tariq mentioned, dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing. Wrenfield tends to click once a second person is in there with you — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whatever's next with you.

Best,
Nadia
